scoring_justification: We recompute stable-material percentages from the per-material CSV and compare to paper-reported values with tolerance, achieving T1 recompute.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported stable percentages for each condition
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's Table 1 values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact numbers reported in the paper for the same six conditions.

schema.description: One material identifier per line. No header. Exactly 3376 non‑empty lines.

outputs.description: List of stable 2D material identifiers from C2DB. Checked for correct count and format.

schema.description: Each row corresponds to one material. All delta_G_pbx values are numeric floats in eV/atom. Missing values not allowed.

outputs.description: Per‑material Pourbaix energies. The checker recomputes the fraction of materials with ΔG_pbx < 0 for each condition and compares to the paper's hidden percentages.

schema.description: Each condition value is an object containing: stable_percentage (float 0-100), mean_delta_G (float eV/atom), histogram_bin_edges (array of floats), histogram_counts (array of ints). The checker verifies internal consistency with step_02 and correct histogram bounds.

outputs.description: Summary statistics and histogram data derived from step_02. Checked for structural consistency and histogram range/bin steps.

output_contract.notes: All outputs are scored; step_01 ensures the correct material set is used, step_02 carries the main computational burden and is load_bearing, step_03 provides aggregated views used for structural audits.

steps.description: Verify the material list has exactly 3376 non-empty lines and no header line.
Recompute stable fraction (<0) per condition from CSV; compare to paper gold with tolerance.
Validate JSON summary structure, internal consistency with CSV, and histogram bins.
